home.how_help: Choose a website, JSON, CSV, or XML source. Map your fields, test a preview, then activate your collector and set a schedule.

setup.website_help: Paste the full address of a public page. Start with the page that lists the items you need.
setup.data_title: What would you like to collect?

setup.source_help: Choose how your source provides data.

flow.draft_help: AI will prepare instructions for collecting your data. You will review the generated code before any browser test starts.
flow.generating_help: This may take a moment. You can leave this page and return later; work continues in the background.
flow.approval_help: The collector is prepared. Review what will run and decide whether to allow a small test.
flow.testing_help: The approved test is running. When it finishes, you can check the sample before using this collector.
flow.sample_help: Open the sample and check the rows and columns. If they look right, choose “Use this version”. Collecting the full dataset is a separate next step.
flow.ready_help: Start a collection using your approved setup. When it finishes, download the results as a spreadsheet-friendly CSV file.
flow.failed_help: Preparation or testing did not finish successfully. You can request a revised collector. Technical details are available below.
flow.rejected_help: This setup has not been approved for use. Request a revised collector to continue.
flow.advanced_help: Inspect previous versions, review code, or request a repair. Each revised collector still needs approval.
flow.run_active: Collect with the currently approved version

result_state.waiting_help: The collection has not returned any rows yet. This view updates as work progresses.
result_state.filtered_help: Try a different search or clear your filters to see all collected rows.
result_state.empty_help: The collection finished without rows. Return to the collector to review the website and instructions.
result_state.failed_help: Any rows collected so far remain visible. Return to the collector to review the setup; technical details are below.
result_state.cancelled_help: This collection was stopped. Any collected rows remain visible. Return to your collector when you want to start again.

builder.title: Build your collector
builder.help: Choose the source, map fields, preview a sample, then activate your manual setup.
builder.csv_path_help: CSV rows are the records; leave this empty.
builder.sample_help: Load a bounded sample from the URL to explore available record and field paths.
builder.sample_placeholder: Sample data is loaded directly from the source URL.
builder.visual_help: Open the source page. Click a repeated item, then click the text or links you want to collect. Choose from the panel beside the preview.
builder.point_hint: Click an item in the preview, then choose what it represents below.
builder.login_help: Enter a selector and type one credential value at a time. Values are sent to the browser session and cleared from this form after sending. Save the authenticated browser state when login is complete.
builder.fields_help: Each field becomes a column. Use the path shown by the sample or a selector found from the screenshot.
builder.comparison_help: Choose stable identity fields and fields to compare between collections.
builder.credential_help: Credentials are restricted to the site origin you enter. Secret values are not displayed after saving.
builder.allow_empty: Allow a completed collection with no rows
builder.request_failed: The request could not be completed.
builder.schedule_help: Choose when this collector should run automatically.
builder.notifications: Email me about changes, failures, and recovery
builder.comparison_empty: No previous collection to compare yet
builder.test_preview_help: Check a small test run before enabling scheduled collections.
builder.records_path_manual: No repeated object list was detected. Enter the records path above.
builder.detail_fields_help: For pages with a separate detail view, list fields to capture after opening each record. Use relative selectors from the screenshot.
builder.invalid_namespaces: Enter valid namespace JSON with string values.

builder.choose_element: Choose the highlighted element below. No selector typing needed.
builder.click_record_hint: Click one item in the page preview to identify the repeating records.
builder.click_field_hint: Click text or a link inside a record to add it as a column.

builder.no_element_selected: Choose an element from the page preview
